packageRules.description: Bump every @scalar/* package together in one PR and never automerge it. The lib inlines Scalar's CSS but externalizes its JS, so all @scalar/* versions must stay in lockstep (see CLAUDE.md 'Scalar version pinning'). A Scalar bump needs manual re-verification of theming/CSS integrations, so it must not automerge. The scalarVersionLockstep test fails CI if the grouped versions ever drift.
